definition: MRT84 stands for Intellectual Developmental Disorder, Autosomal Recessive 84 (OMIM #620401), an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder caused by bi-allelic variants in the SGSM3 gene and characterized clinically by impaired intellectual development (ranging from mild to moderate) and mild dysmorphic features.
